B1→B2 Travel Series ~55s

Ordering at a Restaurant

100Ls Shadowing Material · Lesson M2-05  ·  ← 上一课
📄 Full Script — Dialogue
0:00 / 0:00
速度：
Waiter
Good evening! Can I start you off with something to drink?
Lisa
Water for now, thanks. Is the salmon dish still available?
Waiter
Yes! It's today's special — grilled salmon with lemon butter sauce and seasonal vegetables.
Lisa
Sounds perfect. I'll have that. Actually, I'm allergic to shellfish — is there any in the sauce?
Waiter
None at all — you're completely safe. Would you like any starters?
Lisa
Just the house salad, please. Oh, and could we see the dessert menu later?
Waiter
Of course! I'll bring it after your main course. Enjoy your evening.
Lisa
Thank you so much!
Waiter：晚上好！先给您来点喝的吗？
Lisa：先来杯水，谢谢。请问三文鱼那道菜还有吗？
Waiter：有的！这是今天的特色菜——柠檬黄油酱烤三文鱼配时令蔬菜。
Lisa：听起来完美。我要这个。对了，我对甲壳类海鲜过敏——酱汁里有吗？
Waiter：完全没有——您放心。要来点开胃菜吗？
Lisa：只要一份招牌沙拉就好。哦，之后可以看一下甜点菜单吗？
Waiter：当然！我会在您主菜后送过来。祝您用餐愉快。
Lisa：非常感谢！

🔗 Connected Speech
"start you off"
/stɑːrtjʊɒf/
Yod Coalescence+Linking
"you" → /jʊ/, links with "off"; smooth three-word chain.
"allergic to"
/əˈlɜːrdʒɪktə/
Reduction
"to" weakens to /tə/ before consonants.
"none at all"
/nʌnətɔːl/
Reduction+Linking
"at" weakens to /ət/; links to "all" smoothly.
"could we see"
/kʊdwiːsiː/
Linking
Smooth chain across three words; no breaks.
"sounds perfect"
/saʊndz ˈpɜːrfɪkt/
Linking
Final /z/ links to /p/ of perfect.
